message:
Let me build the library with ASAN and the fuzz target to test the PoC:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g" 2>&1 | tail -5 && make -j4 2>&1 | tail -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
